name: compact-revision-controls
goal: Branch and commit controls use one compact row with middle-shortened long values and full accessible values

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Compact row, bounded fields, middle shortening, full native values and hover status are specified.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing shell and workspace tests now bound revision geometry and exercise long selected branch names; shared Select coverage preserves full option values.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only 81c74c19; both existing shell and shared-renderer cases fail the compact revision row height assertion before repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Shared Select adds compact display without changing native values. Both navbars use inline icons, hover details and one bounded revision row. Opus returned no edits after four minutes; authorized fallback completed styling.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Frozen shell and shared-renderer checks pass at d6b514e6; green 0488f81d7371de1ce535aa4ace98322e69437f0011f25e1044fb72848f6fe73a preserves the same tests and command as red 7c922c24.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports check passed: 575 units, types/lint/builds/audit. Browser suites passed: 76 shell, 6 routes and 27 shared-renderer cases; 13 shared-impact tests passed. Manual historical selection, return-to-tip and tablet screenshot inspected. Native and aggregate checks remain paused.
